name: Grim Batol
summary: Grim Batol's gates remain sealed above the eastern Wetlands. The Wildhammer dwarves abandoned the fortress after a curse during the War of the Three Hammers, and the Dragonmaw orcs later used it as a dragon-breeding lair.

sections.title: A Fortress Twice Cursed
sections.body: Thane Khardros Wildhammer carved Grim Batol from the jagged mountains east of the marsh after the ancient civil war among the three clans. During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud laid siege to the fortress. Khardros struck her down, but before she died, Modgud cast a foul shadow across its stones. The lingering taint made the halls uninhabitable, and the surviving Wildhammer dwarves abandoned their kingdom and migrated north into the Hinterlands.

sections.title: Chains of the Dragon Queen
sections.body: During the Second War, Orgrim Doomhammer sent the Dragonmaw clan to claim Grim Batol. The warlock Nekros Skullcrusher led the orcs, who used the ancient artifact called the Demon Soul to enslave the red Dragonqueen Alexstrasza deep beneath the mountain. Chained there, Alexstrasza was forced to hatch broods for the Horde's war effort until a small band of heroes shattered the artifact. Freed, the enraged Dragon Aspect incinerated the orcs within. Grim Batol was left a desolate ruin, watched closely by surviving red dragons.

aliases: can i go inside grim batol
faq.answer: No. The colossal stone gates at the end of the mountain road remain barred to travelers. You can visit only the gates and exterior battlements in the eastern Wetlands mountains.

faq.q: Why did the Wildhammer dwarves abandon it?
aliases: why did dwarves leave grim batol
faq.answer: During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud laid a vile shadow curse on Grim Batol before she was slain. The taint made the fortress unlivable, driving the Wildhammers to abandon it and build Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What happened to the Dragonmaw orcs who lived here?
aliases: what happened to the orcs here
faq.answer: The mage Rhonin and his companions shattered the Demon Soul, freeing the captive Dragonqueen Alexstrasza from her chains. Enraged by her captivity, she and her brood incinerated Nekros Skullcrusher and broke the Dragonmaw presence in the fortress.

faq.q: Who controls Grim Batol right now?
aliases: who lives in grim batol now
faq.answer: Grim Batol is an abandoned ruin. Remnants of the Dragonmaw clan and wild beasts linger in the surrounding crags, while the Red Dragonflight watches the cursed mountain to guard against a return of its dark history.

angles.text: For a dwarf, Grim Batol recalls the War of the Three Hammers: a once-proud sister city to Ironforge, made unlivable by Dark Iron sorcery.
For the Horde, Grim Batol recalls the Second War, when the Dragonmaw clan used enslaved dragons to conquer the skies before their violent ruin.
